expected_answer: select t3.drug from ( select t2.drug, dense_rank() over ( order by count(*) desc ) as c1 from ( select admissions.subject_id, procedures_icd.charttime from procedures_icd join admissions on procedures_icd.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id where procedures_icd.icd9_code = ( select d_icd_procedures.icd9_code from d_icd_procedures where d_icd_procedures.short_title = 'spinal tap' ) ) as t1 join ( select admissions.subject_id, prescriptions.drug, prescriptions.startdate from prescriptions join admissions on prescriptions.hadm_id = admissions.hadm_id ) as t2 on t1.subject_id = t2.subject_id where t1.charttime < t2.startdate and datetime(t1.charttime,'start of month') = datetime(t2.startdate,'start of month') group by t2.drug ) as t3 where t3.c1 <= 5
